what: Add `impl salsa::plumbing::interned::NamesIds for ExpressionStoreOwnerId` in crates/hir-def/src/lib.rs, pushing the salsa id of the variant's inner id (Signature(GenericDefId) / Body(DefWithBodyId) / VariantFields(VariantId): `out.push(salsa::plumbing::AsId::as_id(&inner))`). Why: ExpressionStoreOwnerId is not a salsa Supertype (overlapping variants), so a query taking it among several arguments (e.g. hir-ty db.rs `closure_exprs(db, owner, ())`) has interned arguments whose `ids` list nothing, and crates/hir-firewall cannot tell that the key is the edited body's: it would report a false leak. Same pattern as the NamesIds impls for Ty/GenericArgs in crates/hir-ty/src/next_solver/ty.rs (vendor/salsa interned.rs NamesIds/IdsOf).
